Source: Epigallocatechin-3-Gallate (EGCG) has been extensively studied for its protective effect against cardiovascular disorders.
Luganda: Epigallocatechin-3-Gallate (EGCG) bunoonyerezeddwako nnyo olw’obukuumi bwe buleeta eri obuzibu bw’obulwadde bw’omutima.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí lóríṣiríṣi lọ́ ti ṣe lórí Epigallocatechin-3-Gallate (EGCG) fún ipa ìdáàbòbo rẹ̀ nípa gbígbógun ti àìsan jẹjẹrẹ agbógun ti iṣan agbẹ́jẹ̀.
Zulu: I-Epigallocatechin-3-Gallate (EGCG) icutshungulwe kabanzi ngomphumela wayo wokuvikela ezinkingeni zenhliziyo.
Hausa: An yi nazarin Epigallocatechin-3-Gallate (EGCG) sosai don tasirinsa ga kariya daga cututtukan zuciya.
Northern Sotho: Epigallocatechin-3-Gallate (EGCG) e nyakišišitšwe go tsenelela ka ga seabe sa yona sa tšhireletšo ya yona kgahlanong le malwetši a go amana le go šoma ga pelo.
Amharic: ኢፒጋሎካቴቺን-3-ጋሌት (EGCG) የስርአተ ልብ ወቧንቧ ህመሞችን የመከላከል ተጽእኖው በዝርዝር ተጠንቷል፡፡

Source: This effect has been attributed to its action on multiple molecular pathways and transmembrane proteins, including the cardiac Nav1.5 channels, which are inhibited in a dose-dependent manner.
Luganda: Okukosa kuno kugambibwa okuba nga kuva ku kukolebwako kw’emiyitiro gya melekyu n’embubi za puloteyini, omwo nga mwe muli emiyitiro gy’omutima Nav1.5, egikolebwako mu kwesigama ku doozi.
Yoruba: Ipa yìí ti jẹ́ èyí tí a ti rọ̀ mọ́ ìṣe oríṣiríṣi ọ̀na mólíkù rẹ̀ àti purotéènì transmembrane, léyìí tó ní ajẹmọ́kàn Nav1.5 ojúnà, léyìí tó ń dínà ọ̀na ìkójọ ìfẹ̀yìntì.
Zulu: Lo mphumela ubangelwe yisenzo sawo ezindleleni zamangqamuzana amaningi kanye namaprotheni e-transmembrane, okuhlanganisa namashaneli enhliziyo e-Nav1.5, avinjelwe ngendlela encike emthanyeni ofakiwe.
Hausa: An danganta wannan tasirin ga aikinta a kan hanyoyin ƙwayoyin cuta da yawa da kuma sinadaran furotin dake tsakanin iyaka, gami da hanyoyi na Nav1.5 na zuciya, waɗanda aka hana su ta hanyar dogaro da shan magani.
Northern Sotho: Seabe se se amantšhwa go kgato ya yona go ditsela tše ntši tša molekhule le diprotheine tše di hlagago go kgabaganya matlalwaneng, go akaretša ditšhanele tša cardiac Nav1.5, tše di thibetšwego go tsela ye e ithekgilego ka selekanyo.
Amharic: ይህ ተጽእኖ ብዙ ሞሊኪውላዊ መንገዶች እና የትራንስሜምብሬን ፕሮቲኖች ላይ ባለው እርምጃ ላይ እንደተመሰረተ ተወስኗል፤ ይህም በዶዝ መጠን ላይ ባተኮረ መልኩ የተከለከሉ የልብ Nav1.5 ቻናሎችን ያካትታል፡፡

Source: However, the molecular mechanism underlying this effect remains to be unveiled.
Luganda: Wabula, enkola ya molekyu eri emabega w’okukosebwa kuno yeetaaga kunoonyerezaako.
Yoruba: Wàyí o, ọ̀nàgbàṣe mólíkù tí ó jẹ́ ìpìǹlẹ̀ fún ipa yìí kò tíì di mímọ̀.
Zulu: Nokho, umshini wamangqamuzana obangela lo mphumela usazodalulwa.
Hausa: Ko yaya, ba a san tsarin ƙwayoyin da suke kawo wannan tasirin ba a yanzu.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, mokgwa wa molekhule wo o thekgago seabe go letetšwe gore o tsebagatšwe.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ከዚህ ተጽእኖ ጀርባ ያለው ሞሊኪውላዊ ስልት አሁንም ይፋ መደረግ ይቀረዋል፡፡

Source: To this aim, we have characterized the EGCG effect on Nav1.5 using electrophysiology and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations.
Luganda: N’olwekigendererwa kino, tukoze enkalira z’okukosa kwa EGCG ku Nav1.5 nga tukozesa amasannyalaze g’omubiri (electrophysiology) n’enkyukakyuka ya molekyu (MD).
Yoruba: Fú ìdí èyí, a ti ṣàpèjúwe ipa EGCG náà lórí i Nav1.5 nípa lílo ìgbèrú electrophysiology àti molecular dynamics (MD).
Zulu: Kulokhu, siphawule umphumela we-EGCG ku-Nav1.5 sisebenzisa i-electrophysiology kanye ne-molecular dynamics (MD) simulations.
Hausa: Don wannan manufar, mun siffata tasirin EGCG a kan Nav1.5 ta amfani da hasashe na ilimin gunadanar da halitta mai alaƙa da wuta da motsin ƙwayoyin halitta (MD).
Northern Sotho: Go fihla go maikemišetšo a, re laeditše seabe sa EGCG go Nav1.5 ka tšhomišo ya elektrofisiolotši le dikekišo tša go fetogafetoga tša molekhule (MD).
Amharic: በዚህም ረገድ ኤሌክትሮፊዚዮሎጂ እና የሞሊኪውላዊ ተለዋዋጭነት (ሞ.ተ) ሲሙሌሽኖችን በመጠቀም በNav1.5 ላይ የEGCG ተጽእኖን ለይተናል፡፡

Source: EGCG superfusion induced a dose-dependent inhibition of Nav1.5 expressed in tsA201 cells, negatively shifted the steady-state inactivation curve, slowed the inactivation kinetics, and delayed the recovery from fast inactivation.
Luganda: Enkozesa ya EGCG yasikiriza doozi eyeesigamiziddwa ku Nav1.5 ng’erabibwa mu butaffaali bwa A201, n’eseetula mu ngeri etali nnungi omuwetoogwali teguseetulwa, n’ekendeeza entambula, ate n’erwisaawo okuva mu butatambula.
Yoruba: EGCG lọ ìdèna àkójọ àfẹ̀yìntì ti Nav 1.5 tí a yànnàná nínú sẹ́ẹ̀lì tsA201, tí wọ́n sún àìṣiṣẹ́ ipò àìsún, ní ìwọ́lẹ̀ àìṣiṣẹ́ kàìnẹ́tíìkì, àti ìdádúró ìmókun láti ibi ìyára àìlèṣiṣẹ́.
Zulu: Ukweqa kwe-EGCG kwenze ukuvinjelwa okuncike emthanyeni we-Nav1.5 ovezwe kumaseli e-tsA201, kwashintsha kabi ijika lokungasebenzeki lesimo esizinzile, kwehlisa i-kinetics yokungasebenzi, futhi kwabambezeleka ukululama ekungasebenzeni ngokushesha.
Hausa: Saka EGCG ya haifar da hanawar Nav1.5 mai dogaro da magani da aka bayyana a cikin sel tsA201, ya canza tsayayyen yanayi na rashin kunnawa mara kyau, rage jinkirin motsin kunnawa, kuma yana jinkirta dawowa daga saurin rashin kunnawa.
Northern Sotho: Tlhabelo ya sehlare sa EGCG e bakile thibelego ye e theilwego godimo ga selekanyo ya Nav1.5 ye e hlagišwago ka disele tša tsA201, e šuthišitše khebe ka tsela ye e sa kgotsofalego ya tšhitišo ya go šoma ga seemo se se maatlafetšego, e fokoditše mosepelo wa dikhaenethiki tša tšhitišo ya go šoma, le go ditela pholo go tšwa go tšhitišo ya go šoma ya potlako.
Amharic: የEGCG ከመጠን በላይ መጨመር በA201 ሴሎች የNav1.5 በዶዝ ላይ የተመሰረተ መከልከልን አስነስቷል፤ እንዲሁም የቋሚ-ሁኔታ ያለመንቃት ኩርባን በአሉታዊ መንገድ ለውጦታል፣ የኬኔቲኮቹን አለመንቃት አቀዝቅዟል፣ እንዲሁም ከፈጣን አለመነቃቃት የማገገሙን ፍጥነት አዘግይቶታል፡፡

Source: However, EGCG had no effect on the voltage-dependence of activation and showed little use-dependent block on Nav1.5.
Luganda: Wabula, EGCG teyalina kukosa ku bwesigami bwa voltage (voltage dependence) mu kukola era yalaga enkozesa y’ekitundu ekyesigami ntono ku Nav1.5.
Yoruba: Wàyí o, EGCG kò nípá lórí àtìlẹ́yìn-fóúlítéèjì ti ìṣiṣẹ́ àti ìhan ìwọ̀m̀ba ògùn sí àwọn ẹ̀yà àìṣẹ́ lórí Nav 1.5.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, i-EGCG ayizange ibe nomthelela ekuncikeni ku-voltage wokuvula futhi ibonise ukuvimba okuncane okuncike ekusetshenzisweni ku-Nav1.5.
Hausa: Duk da haka, EGCG ba shi da wani tasiri a kan dogaro da ƙarfin lantarki na kunnawa kuma ya nuna ƙarancin amfani mai dogara a kan Nav1.5.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, EGCG ga se ya ba le seabe go boithekgo bja bolthetše ya phethagatšo le go bontšha poloko ye nnyane ya go ithekga ka tšhomišo go Nav1.5.
Amharic: ነገር ግን EGCG በቮልቴጅ ላይ በተማመነው መነቃቃት ላይ ምንም አይነት ተጽእኖ አልነበረውም፤ በተጨማሪ በ Nav1.5 ላይ ትንሽ የአጠቃቀም-ጥገኛ ብሎክ አሳይቷል፡፡

Source: Finally, MD simulations suggested that EGCG does not preferentially stay in the center of the bilayer, but that it spontaneously relocates to the membrane headgroup region.
Luganda: Ekisembayo, okugeegeenya kwa MD kwalaga nti EGCG tasigala wakati w’emyaliirobbirye naye ng’egenda mu kifo ekirala mu ngeri etali ntegeke n’edda mu kifo ky’embuzi.
Yoruba: Lákòótán, ìgbèrú MD fihàn pé EGCG kì í wà ní àárín ipeleoníbejì, ṣùgbọ́n tí a yára gbé fò sí ipá ọ̀wọ́ orí mẹ́ḿbíríìnì.
Zulu: Ekugcineni, ukulingisa kwe-MD kuphakamise ukuthi i-EGCG ayihlali ngokukhetha phakathi nendawo yongqimba olubili, kodwa ukuthi ithuthele ngokuzenzakalelayo endaweni ye-membrane headgroup.
Hausa: A ƙarshe, kwaikwayon MD sun bayar da shawarar cewa EGCG ba ya fifita zama a tsakiyar shimfiɗa biyu, amma cewa ta sake komawa yankin tantani kai tsaye.
Northern Sotho: Sa mafelelo, dikekišo tša MD di šišintše gore EGCG ga e dule bokaone ka bogareng bja llaya ya bobedi, eupša e hudugela ntle le tšhušumetšo go tikologo ya letlalwana la legoro la hlogo.
Amharic: በመጨረሻ የሞ.ተ ሲሙሌሽኖች እንደጠቆሙት EGCG የባይሌየሩ ማእከል ላይ በምርጫው አይቆይም፤ ነገር ግን በድንገት ወደ ሽፋኑ ዋና ቡድን ክልል ይዘዋወራል፡፡

Source: Moreover, no sign of spontaneous crossing from one leaflet to the other was observed, indicating a relatively large free energy barrier associated with EGCG transport across the membrane.
Luganda: Ebyo nga biri awo, tewali kabonero ka kusala mu ngeri etali ntegeke okuva ku kikoola ekimu okudda ku kirala akaalabwako, kino nga kiraga nti waliwo okuggalirwa kw'amaanyi ageekwanya ku ntambula ya EGCG mu mbubi.
Yoruba: Àti pé, kò sí àmi ìyára sọdá láti ojúewé sí òmíràn, léyìí tó ń fi ìdíwọ́ agbára ńlá ọ̀fẹ́ tó wà pẹ̀lú ìrìǹká EGCG káàkiri mẹ́ḿbíìnì náà.
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwalokho, alukho uphawu lokuwela ngokuzenzekelayo usuka kwelinye ipheshana uye kwelinye oluphawuliwe, okubonisa umgoqo wamandla wamahhala omkhulu ngokuqhathaniswa ohlobene nokuhamba kwe-EGCG ngaphesheya kolwelwesi.
Hausa: Haka kuma, ba a ga alamar hayewa kai tsaye daga wannan takarda zuwa wancan ba, wanda ke nuni da wani babban shingen makamashi na kyauta wanda ke da alaƙa da jigilar EGCG a cikin tsakanin tantani.
Northern Sotho: Go feta fao, ga go leswao la go kgabaganya ka ntle le tšhušumetšo go tloga go letlakalana le tee go ya go le lengwe leo le lemogilwego, go laetša lepheko la go hloka enetši le lennyane gannyane le le amanago le tshepetšo ya EGCG go kgabaganya letlalwana.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ፣ ከአንድ ነጠላ ቅጠል ወደሌላ በድንገት የመዘዋወር ምንም ምልክት አልታየም፡፡ ይህም በሽፋኑ ዙሪያ ከEGCG መጓጓዝ ጋር የተያያዘ ትልቅ እና ነጻ የሃይል አግዳ እነዳለ ያሳያል፡፡

Source: These results indicate that EGCG may exert its biophysical effect via access to its binding site through the cell membrane or via a bilayer-mediated mechanism.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu ebyo biraga nti EGCG eyinza okussa ebinnyonnyolanfaanana byayo ng’eyitira mu mu kifo kyayo mu butaffaali bw’olububi oba ng’eyitira mu nkola ey’emyaliirobbirye.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì yí fi hàn pé EGCG lè lo ipa ìfètò-ohun-abẹ̀mí látara ìfàyègbà sí ibi ìdi rẹ̀ nípa mẹ́ḿbírìnì sẹ́ẹ̀lì tàbí nípa ọ̀nàgbàṣe ipeleoníbejì.
Zulu: Le miphumela ibonisa ukuthi i-EGCG ingase isebenzise umphumela wayo we-biophysical ngokufinyelela kusayithi layo elibophezelayo ngolwelwesi lweseli noma ngendlela yongqimba olubili-mediated.
Hausa: Waɗannan sakamakon suna nuna cewa EGCG na iya yin tasirin halin halitta ta hanyar samun damar shiga wurin ɗaure ta ta tantanin halitta ko ta hanyar sadarwa ta shimfiɗa biyu.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tše di laetša gore EGCG e ka gatelela seabe sa yona sa payofisikhale ka tsela ya phihlelelo go karolo ya kopantšho ya yona ka tsela ya letlalwana la sele goba ka mokgwa wa kgokaganya ka dillaga tše pedi.
Amharic: እነዚህ ውጤቶች እንደሚጠቁሙት EGCG የባዮፊዚካል ተጽእኖውን በአያያዥ ጣቢያው አማካኝነት በሴል ሽፋን ወይም በባይሌየር በታገዘ ስልት ያገኛል፡፡

Source: In 2020, researchers showed for the first time in a laboratory setting that a molecule found in green tea can block the signals that trigger irregular heartbeats.
Luganda: Mu 2020, abanoonyereza baalaga omulundi ogusookedde ddala mu ggezeserezo nti ekirungo ekisangibwa mu majaani ag’ebikoola kisobola okuziyiza obubagulizo obuleetera enkuba y’omutima etali ya bulijjo.
Yoruba: Ní 2020, àwọn olùṣèwádìí hàn nínú láàbù fúngbà àkọ́kọ́ pé mólíkù tí à ń rí nínú tíì aláwọ̀ ewé lè ṣe ìdènà fún ohun tó ń fa ìṣe ṣégeṣège ìmí ọkàn.
Zulu: Ngo-2020, abacwaningi babonisa okokuqala endaweni yaselabhorethri ukuthi i-molecule etholakala etiyeni eliluhlaza ingavimba izimpawu ezibangela ukushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile.
Hausa: A cikin shekara ta 2020, masu bincike sun nuna a karon farko a cikin ɗakin gwaje-gwaje cewa ƙwayar halitta da aka samu a cikin koren shayi na iya toshe siginar da ke haifar da bugun zuciya na yau da kullum.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2020, banyakišiši ba laeditše lekga la mathomo go tikologo ya laporathori leo molekhule wo o hweditšwego ka teyeng ye tala o ka thibelago disiknale tše di hlohleletšago go thebetha ga pelo ka tsela ya go se tlwaelege.

Northern Sotho: Sa mafelelo, ba šomišitše mmotlolo go bona ka moo EGCG e sepelago ka gona ka go letlalwana la sele, seo e lego moo tšhanele ya sodiamo e kgokaganago le bokagare bja sele go ya go bokantle bja sele go tliša sodiamo.
Amharic: በመጨረሻ EGCG አንዴት በሴል ሽፋን ላይ እንደሚንቀሳቀስ ለማየት ሞዴሊንግን ተጠቀሙ፤ ይህም ሶዲየምን ለማምጣት የሶዲየም ቻናሉ የሴሉን ውስጥ ከሴሉ ውጪ ጋር የሚያገናኝበት ቦታ ነው፡፡
